Limo Rental Tempe: Your Complete Guide to ASU Events & College Celebrations

Renting a limo in Tempe starts at $125 per hour for our 6-seat Luxury SUV and $175 per hour for a 13- or 16-seat Limo Party Sprinter, each with a 4-hour minimum. A 4-hour graduation-day booking in the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) is $700, about $54 per person for a full van of family.

Tempe is the heart of Arizona's college scene, home to Arizona State University and tens of thousands of students ready to celebrate. Whether it is graduation, a football Saturday, or a 21st birthday on Mill Avenue, the right transportation turns a good event into an unforgettable one.

ASU Graduation Transportation

Why Graduation Needs Planned Transportation

  • Parking: graduation draws enormous crowds to the lots around Desert Financial Arena
  • Family coordination: grandparents, siblings, cousins, everyone arriving separately
  • Photos: a Sprinter plus a grad gown is a great picture
  • The celebration after: dinner reservations and nobody driving after champagne

Graduation Day Timeline

Morning ceremony

  • 8:00 AM pickup from hotel or home
  • 8:45 AM arrive on campus, time for photos
  • 10:00 AM-12:00 PM ceremony
  • 12:00-12:30 PM photos
  • 1:00 PM lunch celebration

Afternoon ceremony

  • 1:00 PM pickup
  • 1:45 PM arrive on campus
  • 3:00-5:00 PM ceremony
  • 5:00-5:30 PM photos
  • 6:30 PM dinner celebration

ASU Graduation Booking Tips

  • Confirm the date: availability varies by graduation weekend, so request a current quote
  • Confirm the ceremony time: ASU holds several; know yours
  • Plan for delays: ceremonies run long, so add a 30-minute buffer
  • One coordinator: have one person manage family arrivals
  • Book dinner the same day you book the vehicle

Graduation Dinner Destinations

Upscale: House of Tricks (walkable from campus), Top of the Rock, Different Pointe of View
Casual celebration: the taprooms and patios around Mill Avenue

ASU Football Game Day Transportation

Why You Need a Chauffeur for Sun Devil Games

  • Tailgate freedom: nobody has to drive
  • Parking chaos: a packed Sun Devil Stadium empties onto the same few streets
  • Group coordination: keep the crew together
  • Energy: party on the way there and back

Game Day Options

Drop and pickup: Executive Sprinter, 5 hours, $725. Drop 2 hours before kickoff, pick up 30-45 minutes after the final whistle. About $52 per person for 14.

Full tailgate: Executive Sprinter, 8 hours billed as 7, $1,015. Arrive 4 hours before kickoff, chauffeur returns post-game. About $73 per person for 14.

The whole day: Party Bus (28 Pax), 8 hours billed as 7, $1,750. Pre-game bar, tailgate, game, post-game celebration. About $63 per person for 28.

Sun Devil Stadium Logistics

  • Drop-off: Rio Salado Parkway works best
  • Pickup: agree on the spot before the game; cell service gets spotty
  • Timing: allow 30-45 minutes for the crowd to disperse
  • Backup: have a second meeting spot ready

Mill Avenue Celebrations

The 21st Birthday Classic

Typical timeline

  • 7:00 PM pickup from the apartment
  • 7:30 PM dinner on Mill
  • 9:30 PM birthday toast and bar hop
  • 12:00 AM midnight (if the birthday is not until then)
  • 2:00 AM pickup and safe return

Vehicle options for 7 hours (6 billed)

  • 6 or fewer friends: Luxury SUV, $750, about $125 per person
  • 7-13 friends: Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax), $1,050, about $81 per person for 13
  • 14-16 friends: Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax), $1,050, about $66 per person for 16
  • 17-28 friends: Party Bus (28 Pax), $1,500, about $54 per person for 28

Drinking on board: passengers 21 and over can drink in the vehicle. Arizona's open-container law exempts passengers in a vehicle for hire such as a party bus or limousine (A.R.S. § 4-251). BYOB, no underage drinking, and the driver never drinks. If anyone on board is under 21, including a birthday guest who is still a few hours short, there is no alcohol on board at all. Fraternity and Sorority Formals

Coordinated pickup: one location for everyone (chapter house or a campus lot), matching vehicles, time for photos before departure.

Popular destinations: Scottsdale resorts, downtown Phoenix venues, Sedona for overnight formals.

What it costs: the Party Bus (28 Pax) for 5 hours is $1,250, about $45 per person for 28. The Mini Bus (24 Pax) for 5 hours is $925, about $39 per person for 24 (minimal luggage). Chapters larger than 28 take the 56-Passenger Motorcoach at $1,625 for its 5-hour minimum, about $29 a head with 56 aboard, or run two mini buses.

Timing: request a current quote for the date, confirm the headcount before the night, and plan for the night to run long.

Tempe Transportation FAQs

How early should I book for ASU graduation?
Four to six weeks minimum. Graduation weekends are among our busiest of the year.

Can we drink in the limo?
Yes, when everyone on board is 21 or older, under A.R.S. § 4-251. We provide ice and cups; you bring the drinks.

What about dorm or apartment pickup?
No problem. Give us the address and any gate or access instructions.

Is there a minimum time?
Four hours on every vehicle, and five on the 56-passenger motorcoach.

What if we run late?
Tell your chauffeur right away. Extra time is billed at the vehicle's hourly rate.

What is the cancellation policy?
Cancellation terms depend on your date and booking; read the cancellation policy before you book. One free date change at 72 or more hours. See policies.
